title: S&P 500 Trailing P/E Ratio (As-Reported)
revision_note: Shiller periodically restates historical earnings figures. The site always shows the latest revision; the gh-pages deploy history is the vintage archive.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
sources.licence: S&P Dow Jones Indices terms via FRED

sources.licence: Free download; no republication restriction found

inputs.label: Trailing 12-month as-reported EPS
inputs.status_note: S&P's public EPS file was discontinued on 31 Jan 2026; earnings are estimated from the last confirmed quarter until a replacement source is found.

methodology: P/E = monthly average S&P 500 price / trailing 12-month as-reported (GAAP) EPS.
Historical months (1871 through Shiller's last confirmed month) use Shiller/Yale's own price and earnings, both confirmed.

Later months use FRED's SP500 monthly average price with TTM earnings from data/earnings_overrides.json (S&P Global quarterly scorecard): a month is confirmed once the calendar quarter ending before it begins is in the file, and estimated (forward-filled from the last confirmed quarter) otherwise.
The current, not-yet-completed month is never included: FRED's monthly average of a month in progress changes daily, while every other point in the series is a full-month average.
notes: The dashed portion of the chart marks estimated months, starting the first month not yet covered by a confirmed quarter.

The S&P Global earnings workbook was discontinued by its publisher on 31 Jan 2026 (see the earnings input's status_note); the P/E has been running on forward-filled earnings since and will continue to until a replacement source is adopted.
